name: @nessgate/resolver
description: Open, neutral universal resolver for the agentic web: give it a domain and get one normalized answer with the machine-readable resources it publishes across ARD (well-known, rel=ard, robots Agentmap), A2A, llms.txt, API catalogs, OpenAPI, ORD, host-meta, Agent Network Protocol, Universal Commerce Protocol and DNS-AID. Adapter architecture; dependency-free; fetches the domain directly.
author: Adam Dean
